name: io.github.iowarp/web-mcp
title: CLIO Web
description: Provider-fixed web search plus transparent URL, DOI, and document fetching

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch an HTTP(S) URL or DOI. HTML and text are read locally; supported PDFs and structured documents use the optional CLIO Search document service.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web using this installation's fixed ddg provider.

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Return only the active installation's search and fetch capabilities.

prompts.name: research_web
prompts.description: Guided search then fetch workflow for researching a topic on the web.
